cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a neon-lit game arcade — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a maintenance shed with a long workbench — types on an open laptop open on the table; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — standing
